final: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS above_average FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
